name: Vibe Prospecting
description:
Turn your Claude agent into a full B2B prospecting platform. Vibe Prospecting finds any company or professional right inside your chat.

Go beyond basic contact lookups: search company profiles, org charts, and company hierarchy to identify decision-makers and their reporting lines, run company search and contact search by name or industry, and track business events like funding rounds, hiring signals, and growth signals as they happen. Find actionable contact info from emails and numbers to social profiles.

Underneath, Vibe Prospecting covers the full stack sales, recruiting, and GTM teams expect: firmographics, technographics, intent data, buyer intent, website traffic, and industry classification by LinkedIn Industry, NAICS or SIC code, plus employee count, revenue data, funding events, and workforce signals for 150M+ companies and 800M+ professional profiles from 50+ live sources, including third-party and alternative data.

Use it to build lead lists, run people search, person lookup, and phone number lookups, source candidates for recruiting and candidate sourcing, and craft personalized cold email, outbound sales, phone number waterfall, and sales engagement sequences. Enrich any CRM or ATS record with fresh contact data and company data, run an email finder plus email verification, append missing fields, and resolve duplicate entities with entity and identity resolution — all without leaving Claude. Layer in market, competitive, and revenue intelligence to sharpen list building and sales enablement.

It's a modern alternative to Apollo, ZoomInfo, Clay, RocketReach, Clearbit, and Cognism: one connector for prospecting, lead generation, account-based marketing, sales intelligence, email customization, and revenue operations, so outreach starts the moment you find a qualified lead in the contact database. Export enriched lists straight to CSV or your CRM and keep every pipeline generation and ICP workflow running on live b2b data.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Vibe Prospecting to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Vibe Prospecting to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://vibeprospecting.explorium.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: Is Vibe Prospecting MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 16, 2026, Vibe Prospecting scores 0/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Vibe Prospecting MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Vibe Prospecting provides these MCP tools: autocomplete, enrich-business, enrich-prospects, estimate-cost, export-to-csv, fetch-businesses-events, fetch-entities, fetch-entities-statistics, fetch-prospects-events, get-dataset, match-business, and match-prospects.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Vibe Prospecting?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Vibe Prospecting in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.

_published_faq.name: Does Vibe Prospecting MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Vibe Prospecting requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Why is Vibe Prospecting failing MCP readiness checks?

acceptedAnswer.text: Vibe Prospecting scored 0/100 on the latest Manufact MCP publishing checklist, below the 70-point checklist threshold. The top failing check is MCP negotiation succeeds (v1/v2). Failed to connect: Authentication required Paste the MCP URL into the Manufact MCP catalog to rerun the scan.
